title: VLMs Trace Without Tracking: Diagnosing Failures in Visual Path Following
abstract: arXiv:2605.15672v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) perform strongly on multimodal benchmarks, yet their ability to reliably follow continuous visual structure remains unclear. We focus on path following, a basic operation that requires following a selected path through successive visual continuations. Before considering complex factors such as crossings or overlaps, we first test whether current VLMs can robustly follow a simple continuous line under controlled settings that remove such confounds. Across frontier models, we find that tracing is already fragile, with this vulnerability manifesting as unstable path preservation in the presence of other nearby paths. Analysis of internal representations shows that information needed to determine the correct path continuation becomes weaker, with this degradation already emerging in the visual encoding stage. translated_title: 视觉语言模型“描迹”而未“追踪”：诊断视觉路径跟随中的失败
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在多模态基准测试中表现优异，但它们能否可靠地跟随连续的视觉结构仍不清楚。我们聚焦于路径跟随这一基本操作，它要求在连续的视觉延伸中跟随一条选定的路径。在考虑交叉或重叠等复杂因素之前，我们首先在消除这些干扰因素的受控设置下，测试当前VLM能否稳健地跟随一条简单的连续线条。在前沿模型中，我们发现描迹本身已经十分脆弱，这种脆弱性表现为当存在其他邻近路径时，路径保持不稳定。对内部表示的分析表明，确定正确路径延续所需的信息会逐渐减弱，而这种退化在视觉编码阶段就已经出现。常见的补救措施无法解决这一弱点：扩大模型规模带来的改进有限，添加（后续内容被截断）……
tldr: 研究发现，前沿视觉语言模型即使在没有交叉干扰的受控设置下也难以稳健地跟随简单连续线条，其根源在于视觉编码阶段就已出现正确路径信息的退化，且模型扩展等常规补救措施收效甚微。
en_tdlr: Frontier VLMs are already fragile at following even a simple continuous line under controlled settings, and internal-representation analysis shows this stems from degradation of path-continuation information emerging at the visual encoding stage—weaknesses that common remedies like model scaling cannot resolve.
